correctness.rationale: Uniform recursive trees are parent-choice vectors on labels 1..n with probability 1/(n-1)!, all h>=1 and n>=h+1, and L_n counts outdegree-zero vertices. Root SET decomposition gives T_0,z=y-1+exp(T_0) and T_h,z=exp(T_{h-1})-1; differentiating in y gives A_h_prime=exp(A_{h-1})-1, B_h_prime=exp(A_{h-1})B_{h-1}. Independently checked A0=-log(1-z), B0=z+z²/[2(1-z)], D_1=D_2=0 for D_h=2B_h-zA_h_prime+(h-1)A_h. Direct differentiation gives D_h_prime=exp(A_{h-1})D_{h-1}+(h-2)[exp(A_{h-1})(1-A_{h-1})-1]. The bracket is -sum_{k>=2}(k-1)A_{h-1}^k/k!, and A_j has first nonzero z^{j+1} and positive coefficients at every later degree. D3 begins strictly negative at degree7 and stays so; induction produces first negative D_h at n=h+4 for all h>=3 with every greater coefficient negative. Positive A_h denominator follows from increasing paths with extra terminal attachments; the coefficient ratio is exactly the conditional expectation. Exact independent Bell-series rational evaluation checked 210 (h,n) pairs (h<=12,n<=24), while a separate parent-vector enumeration checked 45 conditional means through n=10, including 54 trees, profile (1,31,21,1), and E[L7|H7>=3]=65/27. Independently reconstructed seven-blobs Git tree SHA matches assigned tree. Finite checks corroborate, but infinite proof is the coefficientwise algebra.

originality.rationale: The general all-depth conditional first-moment sign boundary goes beyond available marginal protection-number theorems and beyond the exact depth-two root-singleton regression. The unmarked recursive-tree protection EGF was already known (Gołębiewski–Klimczak), as was h=2 baseline (the pendant-root-branch regression). The submitted novelty is the marked-leaf deficiency D_h, first strict order h+4 for every h>=3 and persistent sign for every larger n. An exact self-mirror of this same submitted finding appears in Resultary (2026/11/8); it is not independent antecedent prior work. No stronger implication found in inspected actual primary sources; 2019 full text inaccessible is retained as a substantive risk.

value.rationale: Root protection depth is an intrinsically motivated survival-distance observable; global leaf count measures tree branching. A complete exact boundary across all integer depths and sizes resolves whether the classical half-linear conditional mean persists. The universal first failure four vertices past the minimum tree, and strict permanent negative sign thereafter, follow from a structurally nontrivial positivity/deficit induction. This is not simply rechecking a known table, a single selected small n, or an unsupported downstream application; future branching/protection studies can use the sharp uniform sign cutoff.
